verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developer page says users can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow', which is a first-party claim of a broad API. Nothing in the evidence lists which UI functions the API exposes, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or markdown docs to verify parity. Missing for 10: documented API reference showing endpoint coverage for UI features (mail scanning, forwarding, check deposit, shredding, tagging, automation rules, account settings), an explicit API/UI parity statement, a machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
